name: Fumoto Hostel
description: Fumoto Hostel is a calm, daylight-filled WordPress theme designed for urban hostels, guesthouses, and independent lodgings. Built around warm serif typography, organic pebble-framed imagery, and alternating white and pale sage palettes, it presents rooms and communal house routines with unhurried clarity. It provides dedicated block patterns for dormitories, private rooms, and neighbourhood guides to welcome travelers with thoughtful simplicity.
